# AMX-30B2 (`amx30b2`) — first-party procedural certification

**Status (2026-08-12): GRADUATED.** The playable is generated by
`buildAMX30B2` in `src/vehicles/profiles/misc.js` from repository-authored
primitives, fittings, and linked-track code. The Ahab GLB remains isolated as
a local visual/measurement oracle; no external geometry or other source-asset
payload enters the playable.

The B2 variant retains the AMX-30's compact five-wheel hull and cast fighting
compartment while adding its fuller rear crown, rear-shoulder service cells,
mantlet camera, stronger supported commander/optic/MG station, smoke banks,
and denser rear service treatment. Its outboard kit is measured as a 3.34 m
silhouette while the nominal hull width remains 3.10 m.
